title: Hayati Pro Max Triple Mango Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Triple Mango delivers an intensely fruity vape focused on one star ingredient. This blend layers three distinct Mango notes—ripe, juicy, and slightly tangy—to create a full-bodied flavour that’s bold yet smooth in all the right places. Whether you're a mango lover or simply after a reliably sweet all-day vape, this tropical triple-hit brings plenty of punch. Made with nicotine salts for faster nicotine satisfaction and a more comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and starter devices. Its 50VG/50PG blend ensures consistent vapour production and clear flavour delivery. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
